modmenu.descriptionTranslation.combind: Expand vanilla keybinds with combo support.
combind.config.title: Combind Config
combind.config.allowConflicts.tooltip: When enabled, all actions sharing a combo trigger together. Disable to have only the first registered action execute.
combind.config.sequenceWindowMs.tooltip: How long after a key press the next press can still count as part of a sequence.
combind.config.sequenceRecordingWindowMs: How long to wait for the next press before finalizing a sequence in the Key Binds screen.
